Resolute Technique
FlavourText: Great tacticians learn that consistency often trumps potential.

Name: Giant's Blood
FlavourText: The Titans did not vanish from this world. Their might lives on - in you.

Name: Unwavering Stance
FlavourText:
Stand your ground, child, keep your senses.
The pain is fleeting, but victory is forever.

Name: Avatar of Fire
FlavourText: "In my dreams I see a great warrior, his skin scorched black, his fists aflame."

Name: Blood Magic
FlavourText: Lay open your veins, and draw power from your own spilled life.

Name: Zealot's Oath
FlavourText: Tear my flesh and splinter my bones. You will never break my spirit.

Name: Ancestral Bond
FlavourText:
A wooden construct, mute and blind.
But fear the wrath of shackled mind.

Name: Pain Attunement
FlavourText:
Embrace the pain, drink it in.
Your enemies will know your agony tenfold.

Name: Chaos Inoculation
FlavourText: Give up everything in pursuit of greatness - even life itself.

Name: Eldritch Battery
FlavourText:
What need have I for defence when my enemies
are reduced to ash and splinters?

Name: Mind Over Matter
FlavourText: While the mind endures, so too will the body.

Name: Whispers of Doom
FlavourText: Your grandchildren will awaken screaming in memory of what I utter today.

Name: Necromantic Talisman
FlavourText: I give you everything, my pets. Do not disappoint me.

Name: Conduit
FlavourText: To me, brave companions! Feel my radiance flow through you!

Name: [UNUSED] Ghost Reaver
FlavourText: I will wear your ghost, and you will die twice: against me, and for me.

Name: Resonance
FlavourText: The notes may change, but the song remains the same.

Name: Eternal Youth
FlavourText: Burn the spirit to vitalise the flesh.

Name: Primal Hunger
FlavourText: The irrepressible spirit of the wilds burns within you, roaring to be let loose.

Name: Dance with Death
FlavourText: You circle the black scorpion with enmity, daring it time and again.

Name: Heartstopper
FlavourText: Skip a beat, hold your breath. Too slow a poison, only death.

Name: Oasis
FlavourText: The fewer there are, the less you have to share.

Name: Vaal Pact
FlavourText:
My ancestral pact was sealed. Forevermore, I would gain sustenance
only from the ravaged flesh of my enemies.

Name: Iron Reflexes
FlavourText: Why should I dodge blows that I do not fear?

Name: Glancing Blows
FlavourText: Utter trust in your defence unleashes ultimate potential.

Name: Elemental Equilibrium
FlavourText: Balance is good in all things, but especially in the realm of magic.

Name: Bulwark
FlavourText: In battle, certainty is worth a little pain.

Name: Crimson Assault
FlavourText: Each nick and cut brings death one step closer.

Name: Trusted Kinship
FlavourText: Bonds forged in battle surpass ties of blood.

Name: Hollow Palm Technique
FlavourText: The body is a weapon waiting to be mastered.

Name: Blackflame Covenant
FlavourText:
Let the Darkness consume you.
Beyond the veil of death,
there burns a black fire.

Name: Ritual Cadence
FlavourText: A properly disciplined mind gives rise to structured thought.

Name: Chimeral Blood
FlavourText: All animals share common ancestors. You carry them within you still.

Name: Scarred Faith
FlavourText: Hope is a mistake. Pain is the only truth.

Name: Lord of the Wilds
FlavourText: Strength begets respect. There is no simpler law.

Name: Wildsurge Incantation
FlavourText:
The world is a pattern, moving in natural waves.
With enough force, those waves can be made to converge...

Cast Speed and Area of Effect
Barya of Navira
FlavourText:
"You knew the twisted plan these fools devised. As Tale Woman, you are their compass in the sandstorm. Yet... you did not act. And now we mourn these honoured dead. You must pay."
 
Varashta condemned Navira to the ritual of the barya, sentenced to serve as a Djinn.

Name: Barya of Kelari
FlavourText:
"And you... there was no excuse for your actions. You defiled them! You have tainted the very sands with the blood of your own! Yet the war rages on. You have achieved nothing. You must pay." 

Varashta condemned Kelari to the ritual of the barya, sentenced to serve as a Djinn.

Name: Barya of Ruzhan
FlavourText:
"You have forsaken your duty to my akhara. Yes... we do not abide weakness. But we also do not abide madness in the fervour of battle! Your slain dekhara will have their justice. You must pay." 

Varashta condemned Ruzhan to the ritual of the barya, sentenced to serve as a Djinn.

Name: Navira's Fracturing
FlavourText:
"My heart was fractured. I believed Kelari's words. I knew not his true nature... his ambition. I convinced Ruzhan there were cowards among his ranks. I failed you. And I accept my fate." 

Navira confessed her failure to Varashta.

Name: Navira's Well
FlavourText:
"Wipe the tears from your face, dear Navira. I did not deceive you. I meant every word. I will forever cherish you, my beloved. Know that I did it all for you... for our future!" 

Kelari pleaded with the Tale Woman.

Name: Navira's Oasis
FlavourText:
"Kelari, you deceiver! I fell for your words, but no longer. Your sentence is a fate too good for you! I would give anything to bring back those who fell to your lies. Instead... I mourn my choices." 

Navira lambasted Kelari a final time.

Name: Kelari's Deception
FlavourText:
"Listen not to his simpering words, he means to languish before you to weaken your resolve! He is duplicitous. An assassin, thriving on deception and lies. His lust for power is what drove his choice!" 

Outrage trembled in Ruzhan's voice at the sentencing.

Name: Kelari's Judgment
FlavourText:
"Knowing where and when to plunge your knife is more important than the sharpness of your blade. I will not forget my error... and I will be a living example of your wisdom, dear Sekhema." 

Kelari accepted Varashta's sentence and committed himself to her.

Name: Kelari's Malediction
FlavourText:
"The snare was set on our fallen. Beetles burst from their flesh, flooding the sands. Their exploding carapaces halted the advancing enemy... but it was not enough. And for that... I grieve." 

Kelari admitted his wrongdoing to Varashta.

Name: Ruzhan's Trap
FlavourText:
"I have seen countless battles. I know war! The taste of defeat... The taste of victory! But in this war... everything is at stake. So yes, those you speak of will know my blade. I will do whatever I must!" 

Ruzhan confided in his Tale-Woman, Navira.

Name: Ruzhan's Reckoning
FlavourText:
"I stand before you, as your humble servant. Though I was betrayed, I would do it all again, if it would have saved us. But I accept your sentence. I will atone. I pledge myself to you... forevermore." 

Ruzhan accepted his fate at the barya ritual site.

Name: Ruzhan's Fury
FlavourText:
"Yes... they fell by my blade and fire lashed them for their betrayal! No dekhara is exempt from fighting back the Winter before us. Lest they too know the Doom of the Desert!" 

Ruzhan fumed at Varashta, in pure defiance.

Name: Corrupted Infusion
FlavourText: We seek to cleanse Corruption, not intensify it, but there may be merit to a paradoxical strategy.

Name: Unstable Energies
FlavourText: Overcharge the machine at your own risk.

Name: Ecological Shift
FlavourText: Everything changes in the wake of Corruption.

Name: Would you like to see my face?
You can't just wake up from this one.
It's not real, it's not real!
